summary: Amylyx Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on August 18, 2026, announcing positive topline results from its Phase 3 LUCIDITY clinical trial of avexitide for post-bariatric hypoglycemia. The trial met its primary endpoint, showing a 55% reduction in hypoglycemic events versus placebo (p=0.000003), and all secondary endpoints. This is a routine clinical trial results disclosure, not a special situation. The filing is informational under Items 7.01 and 8.01, with no transactional or structural elements such as M&A, financing, or corporate actions.
